supersedes.schema: Nothing: purely additive (no constraint, function, index or policy redefined). Existing rows are not modified; they start at version 1.
client: src/lib/supabase/pantry.ts replacePantryItemsInSupabase / savePantryItemsToSupabase: DELETE of every pantry row of the user followed by one INSERT of the whole list on every change (replaced by add_pantry_items, set_pantry_items_active and delete_pantry_items, one item per write). A failure between both requests emptied the account pantry.
Pantry version as the latest updated_at of the list, compared by a separate read before writing (now pantry_items.version per row, compared inside each function).
Whole-pantry conflicts: two devices changing different items refused or duplicated each other (now only a change to the same item since it was read is refused).
supersedes.rollout: The previous client keeps replacing and reading the pantry with this migration applied; the new client re-reads the items it replaced and never duplicates them (scripts/pantry-db-tests.cjs, scenario 8).

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER set_pantry_items_version BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.pantry_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION pantry_items_set_version()
